An '''advisor''' was an individual that gave advice to another individual, such as a politician, head of state, bureaucrat, or military leader. An advisor provided advice on many important issues, including politics, diplomacy, military strategy, and so forth.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] '''clone advisors''' were an individual who served as an advisor to a specific [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. Their duty was to inform the squad about their missions, status, and objectives.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando" />

Besides actual [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], it was rumored that some or all of the [[Cuy'val Dar]] were used as clone advisors during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Because of the secrecy surrounding these individuals, knowledge is scarce as to their official role as support personnel. One trooper named [[01/425]] served as a clone advisor to [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]].<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] dispatched advisors to counsel groups and [[Species/Legends|species]] looking to oppose the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. These advisors were familiar with resistance tactics and operations, and taught the skills to their allies. A team of advisors were assigned to assist the [[Sessehshellah]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shaymore]] in their fight to destroy Imperial [[hydrocarbon]] operations. Initially, the Sesselshellah were contemptuous of the advisors, believing they lacked courage because of the degree of caution and practicality the Alliance team attempted to instil in their plans. Over time, the advisors and Sesselshellah came to respect one another's skills; the Sesselshellah appreciating the shrewdness and cleverness of the Alliance advisors, while the Rebels learned to see the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] were experts on their own native environment and how to use their own special talents agains the Empire.<ref name="Rings" />
